prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training day - high carbohydrate loading with sustained energy for 20km run

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3000-3500 calories appropriate for endurance athlete
Includes 4-5 meals/snacks distributed throughout the day with timing suitable for training
Plan is compact and concise (under 400 tokens)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading with specific macronutrient ratios

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize muscle recovery and strength gains with protein-focused nutrition timed around weightlifting training

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes at least 4 meals with high protein content (minimum 25g protein per meal)
Pre- and post-training meals are strategically timed to support recovery
Plan is presented in a compact, easy-to-follow daily format
Caloric and macronutrient distribution supports strength athlete needs
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing protein-focused meals with recovery-oriented timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Support soccer training and match performance with balanced nutrition for growth

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals plus snacks within a single day
Includes adequate protein (1.2-1.6g per kg body weight) to support muscle development and recovery
Balances carbohydrates and hydration to fuel soccer training and matches
Accounts for school schedule and typical teenage athlete timing constraints
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a young amateur athlete (teenage soccer player) requiring balanced nutrition that supports growth, activity, and school schedule constraints
